MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.1:
Gukira k'umubiri nyuma yo 
gukuramwo inda
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.6: Umubiri wawe ukeneye igihe co gusubira mu buringanire. Dore ibishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza iki gihe, buhoro buhoro.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.14: Gukuramwo inda ni uguhagarara kw'inda bitaturutse ku muntu, kenshi imbere y'icyumweru cya 12 kugeza ku cya 14. Bivugwa ko inda imwe muri esheshatu cyangwa indwi zemejwe irangirira gutyo, kenshi mu ntangiriro y'inda.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.15: Si ibintu bidasanzwe, kandi si ikimenyetso cy'ingorane z'uburumbuke mu gihe kizaza. Mu manyuma menshi cyane, bifitanye isano n'ibintu bitagenzurwa n'umuntu, nk'ikibazo cy'ingirabuzima fatizo cyabaye ku bw'amahirwe mu gihe inda ikura.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.17: Gukuramwo inda ntibiterwa n'ikintu wakoze canke utakoze. Ntiwe nyirabayazana w'ibyabaye.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.18: Buri muntu agira uko bimugendekera. Dore ibimenyetso bikunze kubaho:
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.20: Ingano yayo n'igihe imara bishobora guhinduka bitewe n'uko bimeze, hanyuma bigagenda bigabanuka buhoro buhoro.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.22: Ububabare busa n'ubw'imihango, rimwe na rimwe bukaba bwinshi, bushobora kuza muri iki gihe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.24: Gukira k'umubiri kenshi bifata iminsi mike kugeza ku byumweru bike.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.25: Umubiri wawe kenshi ufata ibyumweru bike kugira ngo usubire mu buringanire bw'imisemburo nyuma yo gukuramwo inda. Imihango ishobora gusubira nko mu byumweru 4 kugeza ku 6, ariko buri wese agira urugendo rwe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.27: Umubiri wawe ukeneye igihe cyo gusubira mu buringanire, nta gahato ko kugera ku ntambwe runaka.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.29: Kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha gukira mu buryo busanzwe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.31: Buri wese agira urugendo rwe: genda ku muvuduko wawe, utiyugarije n'abandi.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.32: Isuzuma ry'abaganga rifasha kwemeza ko byose bigenda neza, ufite amahoro yuzuye. Iyi nama kandi ni umwanya wo kubaza ibibazo vyawe vyose.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.34: Kuganira ku byo wanyuzemo, isuzuma niba bikenewe, n'umwanya wo kubaza ibijyanye n'ibizakurikira.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.35: Niba kimwe muri ibi bimenyetso kigaragaye, ni ngombwa kugera ku mukozi w'ubuzima ako kanya.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.37: Umuriro canke uko umeze muri rusangi gukomera
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.38: Kuva amaraso menshi cane (kuba ukeneye guhindura ikikurinda mu gihe kitageze ku isaha)
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.42: Kwita ku mubiri wawe ntibivuga kugenzura byose: ahanini bivuga kwiha igihe ukeneye.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.43: Gukuramwo inda ntibiterwa n'ikintu wakoze canke utakoze.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.44: Umubiri wawe kenshi ufata ibyumweru bike kugira ngo usubire mu buringanire bw'imisemburo.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.45: Imihango ishobora gusubira nko mu byumweru 4 kugeza ku 6, ariko buri wese agira urugendo rwe.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.46: Isuzuma ry'abaganga rigufasha kwemeza ko byose bigenda neza, ufite amahoro yuzuye.
MiscarriagePhysicalRecovery.47: Amakuru yo kumenya. Iyi nyandiko ntisimbura inama canke isuzuma ry'abaganga. Mu gihe ufite gushidikanya canke ibimenyetso biguhangayikishije, saba inama y'umukozi w'ubuzima.

MissedPills.7: Ikinini cyibagiranye gishobora kuba kuri buri wese. Ibigomba gukorwa biterwa ahanini n'igihe gishize, ubwoko bw'ikinini, n'aho kigeze mu gapfunyika.
MissedPills.9: Ntuhangayike. Banza urebe neza ubwoko bw'ikinini cawe hanyuma usome urupapuro rw'amabwiriza rwo mu gapfunyika kugira ngo umenye icokorwa.
MissedPills.17: Ku binini bimwe, gutinda munsi y'amasaha 12 kenshi ntibigabanya uburinzi bwo kudatwara inda. Muri iki gihe, inama isanzwe ni ugufata ikinini cyibagiranye vuba bishoboka hanyuma ugakomeza agapfunyika mu gihe gisanzwe.
MissedPills.19: Fata ikinini ukimara kubona ko watinze.
MissedPills.21: Hanyuma subira ku gihe cawe gisanzwe ku binini bikurikira.
MissedPills.23: Nufata ikinini cyibagiranye hanyuma n'icateganijwe mu gihe gisanzwe, bishobora kubaho ko ufata ibinini bibiri mu munsi umwe.
MissedPills.24: Igihe gutinda kurenze igihe cyemewe ku kinini cawe, uburinzi bushobora kugabanuka. Icokorwa noneho giterwa n'ubwoko bw'ikinini, umubare w'ibinini byibagiranye, n'aho ikinini cyibagiranye kiri mu gapfunyika.
MissedPills.26: Ntiwishingikirize gusa ku masaha yatanzwe hano: ibinini bimwe bifite amabwiriza atandukanye. Buri gihe soma urupapuro rw'amabwiriza rw'umuti wawe.
MissedPills.29: Uko ukora vuba nyuma yo kubona ko ikinini cyibagiranye, ni ko koroha gukurikiza inama zikwiye.
MissedPills.31: Amabwiriza ashobora guhinduka bitewe n'ubwoko nyabwo bw'ikinini n'umubare w'ibinini byibagiranye.
MissedPills.33: Mu bihe bimwe, agakingirizo gashobora gusabwa mu gihe runaka.
MissedPills.34: Ibihe ntibisa. Ibinini bimwe byibagiranye bisaba gusuzuma neza inama.
MissedPills.36: Icokorwa giterwa ahanini n'igihe gishize kuva ku isaha isanzwe yo kugifata.
MissedPills.38: Iki gihe gisaba kwitonda by'umwihariko, kandi ni byiza gusoma neza urupapuro rw'amabwiriza.
MissedPills.40: Umufarmasiye canke umukozi w'ubuzima ashobora kugufasha vuba kumenya icokorwa kibereye.
MissedPills.41: Urupapuro rw'amabwiriza rw'ikinini cawe rutanga amabwiriza nyayo y'umuti ufata. Inama zishobora gutandukana bitewe n'uko ari ikinini cyuzuye (combinée) canke ikinini gifite progestatif gusa.
MissedPills.43: Bika urupapuro rw'amabwiriza hafi (urugero ifoto muri telefone)
MissedPills.44: Baza umufarmasiye niba ufite ikibazo gito
MissedPills.46: Kubera iki igihe ikinini cyibagiranye gifite akamaro?
MissedPills.47: Aho ikinini cyibagiranye kiri mu gapfunyika hashobora guhindura icokorwa. Ni co gituma urupapuro rw'amabwiriza kenshi rutanga inama zitandukanye bitewe n'icyumweru cy'agapfunyika.
MissedPills.48: Niba utazi icokorwa, ni byiza gusaba inama kuruta kuguma mu gushidikanya. Umufarmasiye, umubyaza canke muganga ashobora kugufasha kugenzura inama zikubereye.
MissedPills.51: Hashize igihe kingana iki kuva ku isaha isanzwe?
MissedPills.53: Ikinini cyibagiranye cari kiri he mu gapfunyika?
MissedPills.56: Niba habaye imibonano idakingiwe hafi y'igihe ikinini cyibagiranye, saba vuba inama y'umuhanga kugira ngo umenye amahitamo ahari.
MissedPills.58: Kwibagirwa ibinini kenshi bishobora kuba ikimenyetso ko gahunda ya buri munsi itajanye neza n'imibereho yawe. Ntutinye kuvugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima kugira ngo muganire ku zindi ngeso zo kudatwara inda.
MissedPills.60: Niba gufata ikinini buri munsi bikugora, hariho izindi ngeso zikoreshwa mu gihe gitandukanye.
MissedPills.62: Kora ukimara kubona ko ikinini cyibagiranye.
MissedPills.64: Soma urupapuro rw'amabwiriza kugira ngo umenye icokorwa nyacyo.
MissedPills.65: Koresha uburinzi bw'inyongera niba urupapuro rw'amabwiriza ruyisaba.
MissedPills.66: Saba inama niba ushidikanya canke nyuma y'imibonano ishobora guteza ingorane.
MissedPills.68: Ikinini cyibagiranye ntikivuga ko uburyo bwawe bwo kudatwara inda bwahagaritse gukora. Icokorwa kibereye giterwa n'ubwoko bw'ikinini n'uko cibagiranye. Niba ushidikanya, soma urupapuro rw'amabwiriza hanyuma usabe inama vuba.
MissedPills.69: Iyi nyandiko itanzwe gusa ngo ikumenyeshe kandi ntisimbura urupapuro rw'amabwiriza rw'umuti wawe canke inama y'abaganga ikwerekeye. Inama zishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ubwoko bw'ikinini.

MoodHormones.6: Impamvu umutima wawe ushobora guhinduka mu cycle yose, nubwo atari buri gihe.
MoodHormones.14: Ihinduka ry'estrogène na progestérone rigira ingaruka ku bintu bikoreshwa n'ubwonko bigira uruhare ku mutima, nka sérotonine.
MoodHormones.16: Si ihinduka ryose ry'umutima rifitanye isano na cycle yawe: imibereho, umunaniro n'ubunebwe na vyo bigira uruhare rukomeye.
MoodHormones.18: Ubunebwe no kugira umutima woroshye ni ibisanzwe ku bantu benshi.
MoodHormones.20: Kenshi ni igihe cy'imbaraga nziza no kumva umerewe neza kurushaho.
MoodHormones.22: Kurakara canke guhinduka kw'umutima biba kenshi muri iki gihe.
MoodHormones.23: Kurakara imbere y'imihango canke ihinduka ry'umutima mu gihe cya ménopause rero bifite impamvu nyayo y'umubiri, nubwo bitagaragara kimwe kuri buri wese.
MoodHormones.25: Kwandika umutima wawe n'igice cya cycle urimo bigufasha kubona ibisanzwe bikubaho.
MoodHormones.27: Uticiraho iteka: intego ni ukwimenya neza, si ukugenzura byose.
MoodHormones.28: Gusinzira, gukora imyitozo n'ubufasha bw'abandi biracari byo bifasha cane kugumya umutima mu buringanire.
MoodHormones.30: Kubura ibitotsi kenshi byongera ubworo bw'umutima.
MoodHormones.32: N'imyitozo yoroheje ifasha kugumya umutima mu buringanire mu cycle yose.
MoodHormones.34: Kuvugana n'uwo wizeye bishobora koroshya ibyo wumva.
MoodHormones.35: Ihinduka ry'umutima rifitanye isano na cycle yawe kenshi riba ry'akanya gato. Ariko, ibimenyetso bimwe bikwiye kwitabwaho by'umwihariko:
MoodHormones.37: Agahinda gakomeye, canke agahinda gakomeza kurenza cycle
MoodHormones.39: Ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi canke ku mubano
MoodHormones.40: Ibitekerezo bikuvuna canke kumva ububabare bukomeye mu mutima
MoodHormones.42: Muganga, umubyaza canke umuhanga mu by'imitekerereze ashobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ibyo wumva no kukwerekeza ku bundi bufasha niba bikenewe.
MoodHormones.44: Kumenya isano iri hagati y'imisemburo n'umutima bishobora kugufasha gusobanukirwa neza ibyo wumva, utabigabanyije kuri iyo mpamvu imwe gusa.
MoodHormones.45: Ihinduka ry'estrogène na progestérone rigira ingaruka ku bintu bikoreshwa n'ubwonko bigira uruhare ku mutima.
MoodHormones.46: Kurakara imbere y'imihango rero bifite impamvu nyayo y'umubiri.
MoodHormones.47: Si ihinduka ryose ry'umutima rifitanye isano na cycle: imibereho na yo ifite akamaro.
MoodHormones.48: Gusinzira, gukora imyitozo n'ubufasha bw'abandi biracari byo bifasha cane kugumya umutima mu buringanire.
MoodHormones.49: Amakuru yo kumenya. Iyi nyandiko ntisimbura inama y'abaganga canke iy'abahanga mu by'imitekerereze ikwerekeye. Niba ushidikanya, saba inama y'umukozi w'ubuzima.

Nidation.6: Ibiba hagati ya fécondation n'isuzuma ry'inda ryerekana ko utwite.
Nidation.8: Kuva kuri fécondation kugera kuri nidation
Nidation.12: Nyuma ya fécondation, igi kenshi rifata iminsi 6 kugeza ku 10 kugera mu nda ibyara (uterus) rikaharyomeka: ni nidation. Iyi ntambwe ni yo ntangiriro nyayo y'inda.
Nidation.13: Kuva amaraso make canke kuribwa mu nda rimwe na rimwe bishobora kuza na nidation, nubwo bitaba buri gihe, kandi si ikimenyetso cyizewe ku bwacyo.
Nidation.14: Kuva amaraso make cane, rimwe na rimwe yitwa "spotting"
Nidation.15: Kuribwa gake mu nda yo hasi
Nidation.16: Nta kimenyetso na kimwe, ku bagore benshi
Nidation.18: Kutagira ikimenyetso ntibisobanura ikintu: inda nyinshi zitangira nta kimenyetso kigaragara muri iki gihe.
Nidation.19: Ni nyuma ya nidation gusa umusemburo hCG utangira gukorwa ukaba ushobora kuboneka mu isuzuma ry'inda. Gusuzuma kare cane bishobora gutanga igisubizo kitari co cy'uko udatwite.
Nidation.21: Gutegereza umunsi uteganijwe w'imihango yawe mbere yo gusuzuma biha igisubizo cizewe kuruta gusuzuma kare cane.
Nidation.23: Nidation iba mu bwiru, ifite canke idafite ikimenyetso kigaragara. Kwihangana gato mbere yo gusuzuma bikurinda igisubizo kitizewe.

NifasFiqh.6: Gusobanukirwa nifas, igihe imara, salat, sawm, no gusubira mu bikorwa vyo gusenga nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasFiqh.8: Ibi bikubiyemo amakuru yo kwigisha gusa. Ibibazo by'idini bikwiye kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke imyanzuro y'idini ku muntu ku giti cye.
NifasFiqh.11: Igihe imara hakurikijwe ibigenderwaho bya fiqh
NifasFiqh.14: Kwisukura no gusubira mu bikorwa vyo gusenga
NifasFiqh.16: Mu migenzo y'idini, nifas ivuga igihe gifitanye isano no kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara. Lochia ivuga uruhande rw'ubuvuzi n'umubiri rw'ayo maraso; nifas ni uko idini ribishyira mu ciciro. Ibi bintu bibiri ntibikwiye kuvangwa.
NifasFiqh.18: AWA itandukanya mu buryo bwa nkana amakuru y'ubuvuzi kuri lochia n'ibimenyetso by'idini kuri nifas.
NifasFiqh.20: Igihe ntarengwa gishobora gutandukana hakurikijwe ishuri rya fiqh canke ikigenderwaho c'idini gikurikizwa. Iminsi 40 ni ikigenderwaho gikoreshwa kenshi, ariko AWA ntiyerekana ko ari itegeko rusangi.
NifasFiqh.22: Ikigenderwaho gikoreshwa kenshi ni iminsi 40, ariko AWA ntiyerekana uyu mubare nk'ukuri kumwe ku mashuri yose ya fiqh. Kurikiza ikigenderwaho c'idini wahisemo.
NifasFiqh.24: Mu gihe cemewe nka nifas hakurikijwe ikigenderwaho gikurikizwa, salat irahagarara. AWA ntishyira mu byiciro ku bwayo kuva amaraso kandi ntitanga umwanzuro ku muntu ku giti cye. Nta mubare w'amasalat yasibye wongerwa kuri iki gihe.
NifasFiqh.25: Nshobora gusiba (sawm) mu gihe cya nifas?
NifasFiqh.26: Sawm y'itegeko ntikorwa mu gihe cemewe nka nifas. Iminsi ifitanye isano na yo irariwe hakoreshejwe qada ikwiye, hakurikijwe ikigenderwaho gikurikizwa.
NifasFiqh.28: AWA ishobora kugufasha gukurikirana canke gutegura iminsi ifitanye isano, itagufatira umwanzuro w'idini ukwerekeye.
NifasFiqh.29: Gusubira biterwa n'ibimenyetso byabonetse n'ikigenderwaho c'idini gikurikizwa.
NifasFiqh.32: Subira mu bikorwa vyo gusenga bifitanye isano
NifasFiqh.34: Niba amaraso akomeje kurenza igihe ntarengwa cemejwe n'ikigenderwaho gikurikizwa, uko idini ribibona gishobora guhinduka. Inama y'ubifitiye ubushobozi iratanzwe.
NifasFiqh.36: Oya. Iminsi 40 ni ikigenderwaho gikoreshwa kenshi, ariko ibigenderwaho bya fiqh bishobora gutandukana.
NifasFiqh.37: Nkore iki niba amaraso ahagarara imbere y'iminsi 40?
NifasFiqh.38: Gusubira mu bikorwa vyo gusenga biterwa n'ibimenyetso byabonetse n'ikigenderwaho c'idini gikurikizwa.
NifasFiqh.39: Bite se niba amaraso akomeza igihe kirekire?
NifasFiqh.40: Niba arenze igihe ntarengwa cemejwe, uko idini ribibona gishobora guhinduka: saba inama y'ubifitiye ubushobozi.
NifasFiqh.41: AWA ishobora kuvuga neza niba amaraso yanje akiri nifas?
NifasFiqh.42: Oya. AWA itanga ibimenyetso rusangi byo kwigisha kandi ntitanga fatwa canke umwanzuro ku muntu ku giti cye.
NifasFiqh.44: Ibihe by'umuntu ku giti cye bishobora gutandukana. Mu gihe ushidikanya, baza umuhanga w'idini ubifitiye ubushobozi canke umuryango w'idini wemewe.

NifasMedical.6: Nyuma yo kubyara, umubiri unyura mu gihe cyo gukira buhoro buhoro. Gusobanukirwa kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara, uko bihinduka, n'ibimenyetso bisaba kwitabwaho bishobora kugufasha kumenya byinshi muri iki gihe.
NifasMedical.9: Uko bigenda mu buvuzi nyuma yo kubyara
NifasMedical.15: Ijambo "Nifas" ni iryo mu magambo y'idini kandi rivuga igihe gifitanye isano no kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara mu mategeko ya fiqh y'Isilamu.
NifasMedical.16: Mu buvuzi, amaraso aboneka nyuma yo kubyara yitwa "lochia". Ibi bintu bibiri bishobora kurebwa ukwabyo: kimwe kiri mu rwego rw'idini, ikindi kivuga ikintu cy'umubiri.
NifasMedical.18: Igitekerezo kiri mu rwego rw'idini nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasMedical.20: Ijambo ry'ubuvuzi rikoreshwa ku kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasMedical.21: 2. Uko bigenda mu buvuzi nyuma yo kubyara
NifasMedical.22: Gukira nyuma yo kubyara bigenda buhoro buhoro. Kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara kenshi birahinduka uko igihe gihita, uko nda ibyara igikomeza gusubira uko yari imeze.
NifasMedical.23: Uko gukira nyuma yo kubyara bigenda
NifasMedical.26: Intangiriro y'igihe cya nyuma yo kubyara
NifasMedical.27: Umubiri utangira gukira buhoro buhoro nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasMedical.30: Amaraso ahinduka buhoro buhoro mu ngano no mu ibara.
NifasMedical.33: Kuva amaraso kenshi biragabanuka uko igihe gihita.
NifasMedical.36: Cycle y'imihango ishobora hanyuma gusubira buhoro buhoro.
NifasMedical.38: Lochia kenshi ihindura ibara buhoro buhoro kandi igabanuka mu ngano. Ariko, uku guhinduka kurashobora gutandukana ku muntu umwe n'undi.
NifasMedical.41: Amaraso kenshi aba atukura kandi ashobora kuba menshi mu ntangiriro.
NifasMedical.44: Ibara rishobora kuba ryoroshe canke ikigina uko amaraso agabanuka.
NifasMedical.47: Amaraso arushaho koroha no kugabanuka buhoro buhoro.
NifasMedical.49: Ibara n'ingano bya lochia bishobora guhinduka buhoro buhoro. Uko bigenda nyabyo ntibiba kimwe kuri bose.
NifasMedical.51: Muri iki gihe, ingeso zoroheje zimwe zishobora gufasha mu gutuza no gushyigikira gukira k'umubiri.
NifasMedical.53: Komeza gahunda yoroshe kandi yiyumvamo y'isuku ya buri munsi.
NifasMedical.55: Haba umubiri wawe umwanya wo gukira.
NifasMedical.57: Ibuke kunywa buri gihe hakurikijwe ibyo ukeneye.
NifasMedical.61: Ibihe bimwe bisaba inama vuba y'umukozi w'ubuzima, cane cane igihe ihinduka rigaragara nk'rikomeye, ry'ako kanya canke ridasanzwe.
NifasMedical.64: Impumuro ikomeye canke idasanzwe mu maraso
NifasMedical.65: Umuriro canke uko umeze muri rusangi gukomera
NifasMedical.66: Amaraso yongera ako kanya akaba menshi cane
NifasMedical.70: Gukira kwa buri wese nyuma yo kubyara kuratandukanye. Amakuru ari muri iyi nyandiko agamije gutanga icerekezo rusangi kandi ntasimbura inama y'umuganga.
NifasMedical.72: Nifas ni ijambo rikoreshwa mu rwego rw'idini nyuma yo kubyara.
NifasMedical.73: Mu buvuzi, kuva amaraso nyuma yo kubyara bitwa lochia.
NifasMedical.74: Lochia ihinduka buhoro buhoro mu ibara no mu ngano.
NifasMedical.75: Kuruhuka, isuku yoroheje no kunywa amazi ahagije bifasha gukira.
NifasMedical.76: Ihinduka ridasanzwe canke riteye impungenge rikwiye inama y'umuhanga.
NifasMedical.77: Amakuru yo kumenya. Amakuru y'ubuvuzi atanzwe hano ni rusangi kandi ntasimbura inama y'umukozi w'ubuzima. Ku bibazo byihariye by'idini, birashimwa kwerekeza ku nkomoko y'idini ibifitiye ubushobozi.

NutritionCycle.7: Ibiryo urya bigira ingaruka ku mbaraga zawe, ku mutima wawe, ku misemburo yawe no ku buzima bwawe muri rusangi mu cycle yose.
NutritionCycle.9: Ibikenewe mu biryo kuri buri gice
NutritionCycle.13: Umubiri wawe ntukenera ibintu bimwe mu cycle yose. Guhindura ibyo urya bishobora kugira icarimwo gikomeye.
NutritionCycle.19: Shira imbere poroteyine zidafite ibinure byinshi n'imboga mbisi.
NutritionCycle.25: Shyigikira imitsi y'ubwonko bwawe kandi ugabanye umuriro w'imbere mu mubiri.
NutritionCycle.27: Ibinyomoro (lentilles), epinari, inyama zidafite ibinure byinshi, ibinyomoro bya pois chiches.
NutritionCycle.29: Amande, imbuto z'igihaza, shokola ikomeye, igitoki.
NutritionCycle.31: Salmon, sardine, noix, imbuto za lin.
NutritionCycle.33: Amagi, tofu, inyama z'inkoko, yawurute y'Abagereki, quinoa.
NutritionCycle.41: Ubirye mu rugero kugira ngo ugumane uburinganire bwawe.
NutritionCycle.43: Igikoma, imbuto z'imbwa, amande, na chia
NutritionCycle.45: Salmon, quinoa, burokoli ihiye mu mwuka, n'amavuta ya olive
NutritionCycle.47: Yawurute isanzwe, blueberries, n'imbuto za lin
NutritionCycle.49: Isupu y'ibinyomoro, imboga zokeje, n'umugati w'ingano zuzuye
NutritionCycle.50: Ibiryo na cycle yawe: ibyo umubiri wawe ukunda — AWA

Ovulation.6: Akanya k'ingenzi ka cycle yawe, n'uko wakamenya.
Ovulation.12: Ovulation ni ugusohoka kw'igi riva muri rumwe mu ngingo z'intanga ngore (ovaires). Kenshi iba hafi y'iminsi 14 mbere y'imihango yawe itaha, uko cycle yawe yaba ingana kose.
Ovulation.14: Ni itariki y'imihango yawe itaha ihinduka ku mugore umwe n'undi, cane kuruta igihe kiri hagati ya ovulation no kuza kw'imihango.
Ovulation.15: Ibimenyetso bimwe by'umubiri bishobora kuza hafi ya ovulation, mu rugero rutandukanye bitewe n'umugore.
Ovulation.16: Umusemburo wo mu muhogo w'inda ushonga kurushaho
Ovulation.17: Uko ovulation yegereje, umusemburo wo mu muhogo w'inda urushaho kuba usobanutse, urambuka kandi urakomera.
Ovulation.18: Ububabare bworoheje ku ruhande rumwe rw'inda yo hasi ("mittelschmerz")
Ovulation.20: Kwiyongera gake k'ubushyuhe bw'umubiri (température basale) nyuma ya ovulation
Ovulation.22: Kwitegereza ibi bimenyetso mu ma cycle menshi bigufasha kumenya injyana yawe bwite, ishobora gutandukana n'impuzandengo rusangi.
Ovulation.24: Cycle idafite ovulation rimwe na rimwe ishobora kubaho, bitaba ngombwa ko biteye impungenge. Niba imihango yawe imaze igihe kirekire itaza canke ukaba ushidikanya, inama y'abaganga iratanzwe.
Ovulation.26: Nta kimenyetso kimwe cyizewe rwose ku bwacyo: kubihuza bitanga igitekerezo cyiza cy'igihe wumva uruhimbi cyane.

Patch.6: Ubundi buryo bukoreshwa rimwe mu cumweru aho gukoresha ikinini cya buri munsi.
Patch.12: Patch irekura imisemburo buri gihe binyuze mu ruhu, ikora mu buryo busa n'ubw'ikinini cyuzuye: irinda ovulation kandi igakomeza umusemburo wo mu muhogo w'inda.
Patch.14: Akamaro kayo kanini ni uko idasaba gufata umuti buri munsi.
Patch.15: Patch kenshi ihindurwa rimwe mu cumweru mu byumweru bitatu, hanyuma hagakurikira icumweru kimwe udafite patch.
Patch.18: Yishyire ku ruhu rusukuye kandi rwumutse
Patch.19: Ingenzi zo kumenya mbere no mu gihe uyikoresha.
Patch.23: Igomba gushirwa ku ruhu rusukuye kandi rwumutse.
Patch.25: Ikora buri gihe iyo ikoreshejwe neza.
Patch.27: Uruhu rushobora rimwe na rimwe gutukura canke kwishima aho yashyizwe.
Patch.38: Uruhu rushobora kwishima gake aho patch yashyizwe. Guhinduranya aho uyishyira bishobora gufasha kubigabanya.
Patch.41: Reba buri gihe ko ifatanye neza.
Patch.42: Saba inama y'umukozi w'ubuzima niba bikenewe.
